title: Sizing rule: maximum aggressiveness within survival
decision: Size by the maximum ruin-counted E[log W]; the survival limit (P(lose 80% in 60 days) <= 5%) is the only thing allowed to cut size
why: Principal ruling 2026-09-30 10:17Z; outranks the 0.02-lot floor where the two conflict

title: Single-name equities: cross-sectional books and the news lane
decision: Share CFDs mint hypotheses only in the cross-sectional class-book families, plus the news and earnings lane
why: Principal order 2026-09-30 11:29Z, amending the 2026-09-06 news-only order

title: Autonomy: no approval asks
decision: Lanes validate and merge their own PRs when CI failures are a subset of live's, pick the recommended default on forks, and raise only what is physically impossible without the principal
why: Principal standing order 2026-09-29, reaffirmed 2026-09-30

title: Subsystem admission rule
decision: A new subsystem ships only with a measured contract showing gain; for anything that moves capital the contract is out-of-sample E[log W]
why: Principal rule; stops organs that are built but never shown to add growth

title: Delegation protocol and repo research memory adopted
decision: context/ holds the delegation protocol, the decision journal and per-sleeve rationale; the box publishes the operator digest daily
why: Principal 2026-09-30: research must be a coordination system, not notebooks and chat that nobody revisits

title: Per-instrument regime kernel: built, not admitted on the bars bench
decision: libs/regime/control_room.py labels vol, trend/range and liquidity per instrument. On the bars bench (24 trend/range sleeves, 2021-07 to 2026-09, 65 monthly re-solves of the live solver) it lost 0.11 log/yr to the plain solve (CI90 spans 0). The allocator consumes it only if the box's run on the desk's real sleeves says GAIN
why: Admission rule; the bars bench cannot license sizing, the real-sleeve run can

title: Live gold-HMM world conditioning flagged
decision: On the same bench the allocator's live recipe (gold daily HMM conditioning every sleeve's worlds) lost 0.10 log/yr to the unconditioned solve (CI90 per day -0.00096 to +0.00017). Not removed: the box's real-sleeve contract run decides, and a removal would go through the desktop pass
why: Measured for the first time out of sample; the per-asset hierarchy the allocator's own docstring asked for is now built

title: Regime-first gating of the weekend-gap trade refused
decision: Keep the ungated gap fade. On 12 FX and metals, 2018-2026: fading the weekend gap earns +0.48R (n=3902); switching to follow it in trending regimes drops the gated book to +0.00R; fading only in ranges earns +0.53R vs +0.44R in trends (Welch t 1.64), a tilt at most, never a gate
why: Reverse-engineering of the seven-strategy operator's regime-first rule; a gate that forgoes a positive-expectancy regime costs growth (Rule 2)

title: Practitioner loops run whole, not as pieces
decision: Each cited practitioner's end-to-end loop (Korean winner, regime-first seven, Scherman funnel, Mini-Quant) is bound stage by stage to the organ and artifact that performs it and checked daily; a loop is COMPLETE only when every stage runs and its capital stage is admitted; the bottleneck is where the next build goes
why: Principal 2026-09-30: reverse engineer fully, whole processes

title: Regime-split producer feeds the gauntlet; no loosening for its near-misses
decision: regime_split_miner runs daily in the proposer step: 12 price-only families x 6 control-room regimes per symbol, deflated over the whole sweep, 5-fold purged walk-forward as a kill; survivors donate as family regime_split. First run (12 assets): 702 cells, 298 cleared cost, 271 of those killed by walk-forward, 27 passed every fold, 0 survived sweep deflation (best t_gross 3.05, deflated 0.04). The deflation bar is not relaxed for them.
why: The principal asked for the regime-split pipeline as a producer, not a parallel library. The split raises per-trade net (NZDUSD trend_ma_cross blended -0.6bp, low-vol range +6.7bp) but divides n, so t falls; lowering the bar would admit the multiple-testing artefacts deflation exists to catch.

title: Box infrastructure: outside alarm, encrypted off-site backup, private network with dead-man rollback
decision: MT5-BoxHeartbeat (5 min) pings the box's own healthchecks.io check and fails it on stale research/gateway/watchdog/disk; MT5-OffsiteBackup (6 h) restic-encrypts bronze ticks, tape and the terminal profile off site, secrets and accounts.dat hard-excluded, graded in OPS_REDUNDANCY; install_private_net.ps1 audits 22/3389 exposure daily and enforces only by hand with a 15-minute self-rollback. All three are NOT_ARMED until their secret file or tool exists.
why: The survey found no box heartbeat, no off-site copy of box-only data and management ports open to the internet. Arming needs a credential only the operator holds; the code records the unarmed state instead of claiming health.

title: Regime kernel: bars-bench verdict is INCONCLUSIVE, and the switch is manual until the allocator patch lands
decision: Corrects D-20260930-006. The bars-bench contract verdict is INCONCLUSIVE (headline geo_asset minus geo, CI90 spans zero), not a measured loss. Nothing on the live branch reads the contract's admits field: the reader is pf_allocator._control_room_admitted() in the desktop-pass patch control_room/control_room_regime_kernel.patch. Until that patch is applied the kernel's switch is manual; a GAIN changes no sizing by itself. practitioner_processes now reports that state as NOT_WIRED instead of RUNNING.
why: Blueprint audit found the earlier wording ('consumes it only if ... says GAIN') described the patch as if it were live.

title: Certified-family saturation steers research without gating
decision: Prioritize underrepresented certified mechanism families while preserving every family floor and every cell. Treat a new session, chart, regime, direction, representation, or asset class as distinct research ground; ticker relabeling and parameter sweeps alone are not independent bets. Sealed gates and capital authority remain unchanged.
why: The certified canon is concentrated and the legacy intake marked different session/chart cells as duplicate variants, wasting judge capacity and overstating breadth.

title: Forward identity healer cannot freeze roster descriptors
decision: Require complete execution identities before freezing or declaring restoration; preserve invalid old identities for archived new-epoch migration. USDJPY active at 10 forward trades was verified read-only and remains untouched.
why: Live GBPMXN records were missing direction, timeframe, cost_hash and data_venue and had falsely restored 77 times. Canonical engine correctly refused them. Fixed descriptor-to-execution construction and shadowed publication variable; 28 focused tests and bug-class lint pass. Production adoption remains blocked by coverage and live-code reconciliation.

title: Judging counters and tested-release delivery repaired
decision: Count first terminal cells separately from changed verdict events; refuse stale coverage backlog; combine genuine shared-library branch data from both CI suites under unchanged floors; allow full suite 90 minutes after two measured 45-minute cancellations; fail closed in Python and Windows if release authority is unverifiable.
why: Live Oct 3 sweep used 18 workers, warmed zero new cells; warmer failed 2328 builds with zero missing bars. Production still fae454c7 and controller codex-cro-manual holds a freshly renewed lease. Existing feeder/buildability fixes are canonical but not deployed. 33 judging regressions and 6 focused release/coverage tests pass; full integration remains CI required, no seal or activation claimed.

title: Allocator refresh preserves complete evidence
decision: Preserve last complete full-universe Hunt12 evidence during a resumable refresh only when original evaluation age and exact current coverage are proved. Serialize Hunt12 writers. Reuse frozen allocator correlation without changing proof results or sealed record prefixes.
why: The live allocator refuses the 46/144 partial sweep; legacy full publication timestamps were refreshed by no-work passes and cannot prove evaluation freshness. Continuous allocation needs a valid completed snapshot and a timely solve.

title: Refresh allocator evidence before expiry and detect suspended producers
decision: Refresh the existing Hunt12 producer after five days while preserving the seven-day evidence expiry. Honor canonical HOLD markers. Inspect canonical resident status instead of accepting PID presence; resume only an old zero-CPU childless interpreter owning no files, and leave ambiguous or active suspended work for review. Enforce declared E8 executor and book freshness.
why: The deployed book aged while an 18-hour suspended zero-CPU Hunt12 worker was reported alive. The recovered sweep completed 144 symbols and 2252 tests. Waiting until evidence expiry guarantees a freshness gap during the replacement sweep. Earlier refresh and explicit resident receipts close these detected failures without changing trading signals, allocation constraints, or validation.

title: Reconcile pending bounded judging dispatcher with the released baseline
decision: Carry the existing PR258 initial-wave concurrency repair into the current runtime-prevention branch. Keep all fifteen judge partitions and their fail-closed union, serial recovery and validation intact; bound only simultaneous child launches to two by default, preserving measured operator overrides. Do not interrupt the active recovery sweep or discard its completed shards.
why: The prior CRO ledger left e998aa20 awaiting delivery. The current released launcher still starts max_workers=n; its fifteen-wide wave failed fourteen children and remains in serial recovery. This is the same observed defect, not a new control plane. GitHub PR creation is currently403 and the combined shell PR/CI action was rejected by automatic review, so deployment still requires canonical integration and exact full CI.

title: Refresh independent replication before the live door on its existing core clock
decision: Move the single canonical independent replication pass into CORE_LEGS and ahead of Tier S door/intake. Keep its replay, cursor, budget, quarantine and six-hour door expiry unchanged. Contract its artifact under MT5-HourlyCore at180 minutes so missed refreshes are detected before live entry is withheld.
why: E8 executor22:05 was withheld by replication evidence last updated15:28. Existing producer rerun reproduced AUDCHF on705 fills; next executor22:10 consumed fresh evidence and returned NO_SIGNAL with guardOK. Always-run protection could not help a verifier omitted from core membership and waiting late in the validation department. Permanent delivery is still blocked by the recorded GitHub controls; no duplicate scheduler or authentication workaround.

title: Observe completed Fusion fills without broker clock delay
decision: Extend the canonical closed-deal history upper bound by one day, as existing order reconciliation does; retain original broker epochs, ownership filtering and ticket deduplication.
why: Authenticated position233700226 contains entry209520348 and TP exit209521615. The UTC-now history query returned neither; a next-day upper bound returned both. This repairs attribution latency without creating orders or changing capital/signal policy. Exact CI and canonical release remain required.

title: Keep judging error evidence and avoid unnecessary graph materialization
decision: Retain OS child stdout and stderr per shard attempt outside disposable output; recognize actual canonical judge and gateway process arguments; refuse stale backpressure as current capacity; stream historical judged IDs and skip graph/card loads for already-recorded verdicts.
why: Production lost 14 of 15 children without their traceback; stale Oct3 backpressure and process names misreported capacity; merge process from Oct6 holds 30GB commit. Preserve all partitions, failed trials, preregistration semantics and sealed gates.
